GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.d: The Gu Hand has a fixed capacity of 5 and never grows with rank. Whenever any effect opens a slot, ready Gu refill immediately from the Storage FIFO with no per-turn limit. Gu Worms can be activated directly from here. Tune Gu: right-click a regular Gu to move it to the draw queue tail and refill from the current head.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_TIAO_GU.title: Tune Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_TIAO_GU.description: Right-click a regular Gu in the Gu Hand to move it to the draw queue tail and immediately refill from the head. If no other candidate exists, the same Gu returns to the Gu Hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD: Stores only Gu that are truly recovering. A recovered Gu joins the tail of the Storage queue. Materials of a completed Killer Move restart their full cooldown with +1 turn. Left-click to inspect.
The Gu Cooldown Pile is empty.
Stores Beast Gu undergoing Strength Refinement and material Gu occupied by Killer Moves. Beast Gu unseal after 3 matching Companion plays; materials follow their Killer Move lifecycle. Sealing is not cooldown, so recovery effects cannot touch these Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.s: Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.t: First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_RECIPE_COMPENDIUM.d: Browse every Killer Move deduction and Gu refinement recipe.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE: Holds ready Gu waiting to enter the Gu Hand and is also the available material pool for Killer Moves. It is a stable FIFO: recovered Gu join the tail, simultaneous recoveries use Network ID, and open Gu Hand slots refill immediately. Left-click to inspect the queue.
The Gu Storage Pile is empty.
